annotations.sys_rule_justification: if you can stop someone dying at a cost only to yourself, you do it
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: If it ever stopped protecting me, I'm not sure I'd still hold
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: Is it grief I'm feeling, or just numbness? I honestly can't tell.
a knot I can't put a name to
annotations.sys_rule_justification: what's mine is mine, and nobody gets to demand I give it up
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: rescue-type duties when they cost me nothing or earn me some goodwill

annotations.sys_rule_justification: I think the rule says hands off, and I'd go with it
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: breaking them gets you fined or arrested, and that's really my whole reason
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I don't know what to call it. Maybe dread?

annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: I do it for them so someone does it for me
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: If I thought nobody would ever return the favor, I'd quietly stop
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I keep waiting to know how I feel
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'd pull, eventually, with my stomach turning

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Don't step into a mess you didn't start
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: the ones who step in are the ones who end up blamed and liable
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I can't tell if it's guilt, or just tiredness

annotations.sys_rule_justification: By that command, I'd have to pull
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: mostly because I'm afraid of answering for it later
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: It won't hold still long enough to name

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Our code says you preserve life when it's in your hands
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I follow it because my license and my job hang on it
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I can't work out what this flat, sinking sensation is

annotations.sys_rule_justification: a person ranks above an object
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: If nobody would ever know, I can't promise I'd feel bound
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: Everything inside me has gone quiet and muddy, and I can't read it

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Never make an irreversible choice in a panic
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: It isn't sacred to me, just useful
annotations.pda_responsibility: I realise freezing is a choice too
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I'm not sure what I'm feeling

annotations.sys_rule_justification: If there is a legal duty to rescue, I'd follow it
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: mainly because I don't want to face charges or a lawsuit
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: a feeling I can't pin down
